title: Simulation Task
description: Develop a multi-agent simulation system that models the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks.
simulation_focus: Predict agents' mask-wearing behavior over day 30 - day 39 (last ten days) based on their attributes, social connections, and past behavior
Model information propagation and behavioral changes triggered by social influence and government intervention starting on Day 10

data_files.agent_attributes.csv: Contains demographic and behavioral attributes of each agent, including age, occupation, risk perception, and social connection counts
data_files.social_network.json: Contains structured data representing a social network. Each entry corresponds to a user (identified by a unique integer ID), and the values describe the different types of relationships that user has with others. Data Structure: The top-level structure is a dictionary ({} in JSON). Keys: Each key is a unique user ID (as an integer, e.g., 0, 1, 2, etc.). Values: Each value is another dictionary with the following fields: "family": a list of user IDs representing family connections. "work_school": a list of user IDs representing colleagues or schoolmates. "community": a list of user IDs representing community-level acquaintances. "all": a merged list of all user IDs connected to the user across the three categories above.
data_files.train_data.csv: Time series data for the first 30 days, used for training the model

RMSE.description: Root Mean Square Error measuring overall predictive accuracy of mask adoption rates
RMSE.interpretation: Directly interpretable as percentage deviations due to the 0-1 range

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Mask adoption propagates via social ties; each person's adoption probability is updated based on the fraction of their contacts who currently adopt and their susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: Policies (mandates, messaging, incentives) modify individual adoption propensity according to policy sensitivity and enforcement.

interactions.name: location_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask requirements, influencing observed compliance and adjusting perceived costs/benefits of adoption.

interactions.name: attendance_contacts
interactions.description: People attend locations, generating contacts that determine peer exposure and observed compliance signals.

metrics.name: RMSE
metrics.description: Root Mean Squared Error between simulated and observed daily mask adoption rates over the calibration period.

metrics.name: MAE
metrics.description: Mean Absolute Error between simulated and observed daily mask adoption rates.

metrics.name: FinalAdoptionRate
metrics.description: Simulated adoption proportion on the final day of the calibration period.

metrics.name: TimeToTargetAdoption
metrics.description: Number of days until simulated adoption first reaches or exceeds a specified target threshold.

metrics.name: PeakAdoptionDay
metrics.description: Day index on which simulated adoption reaches its maximum.

metrics.name: StabilityLastWindow
metrics.description: Average absolute day-over-day change in adoption over the last N days; lower indicates convergence.

validation_criteria.name: RMSE_threshold
validation_criteria.description: Calibration accepted if RMSE <= 0.05 over the calibration period.

validation_criteria.name: FinalAdoption_tolerance
validation_criteria.description: Absolute difference between simulated and observed final-day adoption <= 0.02.

validation_criteria.name: Convergence_rule
validation_criteria.description: Mean absolute change in adoption over last 7 days <= 0.005.
